title: Over the Earth
caption: The whole 820 m ship from the bow quarter: the two drums, the spine with its drop pods and water tanks, and the three-chamber drive at the far end.

title: The two drums
caption: Each 200 m drum is three pressure hoops side by side on six elevator spokes, tied to its turning sleeve with stay rods; the two turn in opposite directions.

title: Under thrust
caption: All three fusion chambers firing behind the shared shadow shield, with the six hot radiators glowing at full power.

title: Vault and pods
caption: The cryo vault inside its ring of six water tanks, with drop pods of machinery, power plant and habitats clamped to the spine on either side.
